transcript.label: Historical price differs from current price
transcript.sql: SELECT p.current_price::text, l.unit_price::text, (l.quantity * l.unit_price)::text AS line_total FROM order_lines l JOIN products p USING (product_id) WHERE l.order_id = 'O12' AND l.line_no = 1

transcript.label: Exact modelling article receipt query
transcript.sql:
SELECT l.line_no, p.name, l.quantity,
       l.unit_price, l.quantity * l.unit_price AS line_total
FROM order_lines AS l
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
WHERE l.order_id = 'O12'
ORDER BY l.line_no;

rows.indexdef: CREATE INDEX products_attributes_gin ON public.products USING gin (attributes)
CREATE INDEX products_capacity ON public.products USING btree ((((attributes ->> 'capacity_ml'::text))::integer))
